title: DARE: Diffusion Large Language Models Alignment and Reinforcement Executor
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework for aligning and evaluating diffusion-based Large Language Models (dLLMs). Its evaluations utilize standard benchmarks for general knowledge, reasoning, mathematics, and coding performance (e.g., MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval) rather than any dedicated analysis of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
